title: Simple Perfection
description: A mod pack to help enhance your gameplay. (I hope) PLEASE READ THE PART LABLED IMPORTANT IN THE DESCRIPTION AS THERE IS INFO ABOUT HOW TO USE SOME OF THE MODS!
body:
IMPORTANT: The mod Axiom is turned off by default as of version 2.0.0 because Axiom and Recolorful Containers caused some errors with the inventory and chat. To use Axiom enable it in the Modrinth app and turn off Recolorfull containers in game via resource packs. Sorry for the inconvenience. Also when rendering a schematic with Litematica do not use JCL for some reason it causes lag and the schematic does not render correctly.

This mod pack has some simple shaders called Complimentary Remimagend that can run on a lot of different PCs.

Journey maps works just like a vanilla map, only without crafting one, and appears in the top right corner. 

WI freecam is an up-to-date free cam that promises to stay up-to-date for a long time.

Essentials helps you to keep track of friends in Minecraft.

Auto Reconnect Reforged is a mod pack that automatically reconnects you to servers, handy for afk on servers.

Fresh Animations is a resource pack that gives all mods a little more life.

Lamb Dynamic lights makes torches glow while in hand without shaders, so if you can't run them but still like that feature this mod lets you keep it! It also makes entities that are on fire glow along with creepers when igniting.

Distant horizons, simply put, adds simplified terrain past Minecraft's default view distance to improve performance and allow for longer draw distances. (It looks really nice in my opinion.)

Even better enchant books, this resource pack makes enchant books look amazing!

Recolourful Containers GUI + HUD (DARK) gives an overhaul to how the inventory and related things look.

Shield By Side puts the shield by your side, just like in third person, instead of it being vertical.

Axiom is like world edit, but better in my opinion.

Litematica helps you take builds you built with Axiom or by yourself and create them in survival or on a server.

JCL or Just colored lights is a shader that makes lights color full!

Make up ultra fast is another shader that runs pretty fast. (please note that the damage overlay is really bright)

There are other mods, but they just help the others run and don't affect the in-game experience.
